blocks.prompt: 5. Find an equation of the function whose graph cuts x-axis at \(x = -1\) and \(x = 1\), and whose vertex is at \((0, -2)\).
blocks.explanation:
Do x-intercepts diye hain, is liye \(y = a(x + 1)(x - 1)\).
Vertex \((0, -2)\) bhi graph ka ek point hai; usay rakh kar \(a\) nikal sakte hain.
Ek achhi baat: vertex ka \(x\) roots ke bilkul darmiyan hona chahiye; \(-1\) aur \(1\) ka average \(0\) hai, to di hui maloomaat aapas mein mel khati hain.
Plan: factor form, vertex rakh kar a, phir simplify aur check.
steps:
Diya gaya: x-intercepts \(x = -1\), \(x = 1\); vertex \((0, -2)\).
Maloom karna: function ki equation.
Tareeqa: factor form likh kar vertex (jo graph ka point hai) rakhenge.

Factor form likhein
\[y = a(x + 1)(x - 1) \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: \(x = -1\) se \((x + 1)\) aur \(x = 1\) se \((x - 1)\).

\(a\) nikalein
\[-2 = a(0 + 1)(0 - 1)\]
\[-2 = -a\]
\[a = 2\]
Kyun: vertex graph par hai, is liye \((0, -2)\) equation (1) ko satisfy karta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-2 = -a\) se \(a = 2\) aata hai; dono taraf ka minus cancel hota hai.

Equation likhein
\[y = 2(x + 1)(x - 1)\]
\[y = 2x^{2} - 2\]
Kyun: \((x + 1)(x - 1) = x^{2} - 1\) (difference of squares), phir 2 se zarb.

Tasdeeq:
\[x_{\text{vertex}} = \dfrac{-1 + 1}{2} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(0) = -2 \;\checkmark\]
Vertex roots ke darmiyan hai aur us ki height \(-2\) hai. \(a = 2 > 0\), to vertex sab se neecha point hai, jo samajh mein aata hai kyun ke graph \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan x-axis ke neeche hai.
